note: Draft 1, read by claude-opus-5-5 (fresh context; Codex out of credits). No major; five minors in four verses. «A faithful, close rendering that keeps the Septuagintal readings (in animam inimicorum, versasti, the tenses of 40:7, supplantationem as 'rasteira', propter innocentiam without a possessive).» Pointing matches in every verse. Two taken, three refused.

outcomes.remark: minor: *super* dropped → 'o que entende acerca do necessitado e do pobre'
minor: *panes* plural → 'os meus pães'
outcomes.reason: *comer o pão de alguém* is the idiom for sharing his table; *os meus pães* is heard as loaves; number is grammar (D2, as D29). Option 2.

outcomes.remark: minor: *a sua* added → 'a rasteira'
minor: *à minha custa* interprets *super me* → 'não se alegrará sobre mim'
outcomes.reason: The Greek is supergaudére's (ἐπιχαρῇ ἐπ᾿ ἐμέ), and 29:2, 34:19, 34:24, 37:17 all say *à minha custa*; *alegrar-se sobre mim* is not Portuguese. Recorded in choices 40:12.

outcomes.remark: minor: *sempre* abstracts *sǽculo … sǽculum* → 'de século em século'
outcomes.reason: D37 rules *para todo o sempre* for *usque in sǽculum*; the first member follows the *a sǽculo* row. His wording is option 4.

note: Draft 1, read by claude-opus-5-5 (fresh context). Seven verses remarked; best 40:5, worst 40:10. «Faithful, sober and mostly sayable … Its weak points are a handful of calques … and one register slip in 'engrandeceu a sua rasteira'. The closing verses (11–14) settle into genuine prayer.» Six taken in whole or part, four refused.

outcomes.remark: *entende o necessitado* heard as empathy → 'o que atende ao necessitado e ao pobre'
outcomes.reason: The fault is mended the Latinist's way (*acerca de*); *atender* is inténdere's (D3). His line is option 3.

outcomes.remark: *leve* heard as 'light'; *sobre o leito* stiff → 'lhe traga socorro no leito'
*sua … sua* clatter → 'toda a sua cama revolvestes em sua enfermidade'
outcomes.reason: In part: the Latin's order taken; *em sua* without the article refused (rule 5); the two possessives are the Latin's *ejus … ejus*.

outcomes.remark: *disseram males de* not idiomatic → 'disseram mal de mim'
*saía para fora* redundant → 'Saía porta afora'
outcomes.reason: The pleonasm is the Latin's (*egrédi foras*) and carries the inside/outside contrast with 40:7; *porta* is an image the Latin lacks.

outcomes.remark: *no mesmo sentido* bureaucratic → 'do mesmo modo'
outcomes.reason: Manner, where *in idípsum* is direction or purpose.

outcomes.remark: *pensavam em males para mim* limps → 'pensavam o mal para mim'
outcomes.reason: In part: the redundant dative left unsaid; the row's *pensar em* and the plural kept.

outcomes.remark: *tornará a ressurgir* doubles 'again' → 'tornará a levantar-se'
outcomes.reason: The Latin doubles it too (*adíciet ut resúrgat*); *ressurgir* is the row's word, apart from 40:11's *ressuscitar*.

outcomes.remark: worst line: *engrandecer uma rasteira* does not exist, register jolt → 'fez grande contra mim a sua rasteira'
outcomes.reason: His verb taken, with the Latinist's article; *rasteira* kept.

note: Draft 1, blind, read by claude-opus-5-5 (fresh context). 18 items, 5 unknown words (vivifique, revolvestes, iníqua, engrandeceu, amparastes). Heard rightly or within the Latin's range: *o livrará o Senhor* (the one who understands), *disseram males de mim*, *Quando morrerá* (the psalmist), *juntou iniquidade para si*, *no mesmo sentido* (both readings the Latin allows), *uma palavra iníqua*, *o homem da minha paz* (my friend), *a sua rasteira* (betrayal), *eu lhes retribuirei*, *me quisestes*, *por causa da inocência* (my innocence), *me firmastes na vossa presença*.

outcomes.remark: *entende o necessitado* heard as sympathy
*à alma dos seus inimigos* heard vaguely; *vivifique* unknown
outcomes.reason: The Latin's word, as 26:12; *à vontade* and *lhe dê vida* stay options; evidence noted on the vivificáre row.

outcomes.remark: sudden 'you' confusing; *revolvestes* unknown
outcomes.reason: The switch of person is the Latin's (and the Greek's); *virastes* is option 2.

outcomes.remark: subject of *se entrava* not audible
outcomes.reason: The Latin names none either; the reader heard the enemy visiting, which is the sense.

outcomes.remark: tone of the question open (taunt or hope)
outcomes.reason: The Latin's *numquid … non* leaves it open; kept on purpose.

outcomes.remark: *iníqua* unknown
outcomes.reason: iníquus → iníquo is the glossary's (kept apart from *ímpio* and *pecador*).

outcomes.remark: *engrandeceu* unclear / unknown
*amparastes* unknown
